metadata.coverage: Bounded central Fremont plus an appended northern Irvington/Zone 3 study extract. Partial coverage in all three study zones; not full-city or complete zone coverage.
metadata.connectivity: Only identical OSM node IDs connect roads. No line-crossing or proximity snapping.
limitations: Partial Fremont coverage; not a complete city street inventory.
OSM data completeness, traffic signals, lane geometry, and all turn restrictions have not been independently verified.
Approximate 3D road widths and generic scenery are visual aids.
Missing maxspeed tags mean unknown speed limits.
Some conditional or via-way restrictions require additional routing support; see unsupportedRestrictions.
